host.title: Host
host.description: The full connection URL of your MongoDB database.

database_includes.title: List of databases to include
database_includes.description: A list of databases names to include in the discovery process. If this list is empty, all databases available on your MongoDB instance will be included.

batch_size.title: Batch size
batch_size.description: The number of documents to fetch in a single batch. Setting this to a smaller number helps reduce the overload on the system, although the extraction time will be higher.

cdc_append_mode.title: CDC append mode
cdc_append_mode.description: When enabled for LOG_BASED replication, uses _sdc_lsn as the _id field to make each change event unique. Also sets _sdc_deleted_at to null for all operations. Useful for downstream consumers that need to track every change as a separate event.

max_size.title: Max batch size for parquet files
